{"id":1594176652,"question_id":3154,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"1 year, 3 months","timestamp":1743583857,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"0 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1594176652/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Maximum Value of an Ordered Triplet I","memory":"21.7 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    long long maximumTripletValue(vector<int>& nums) {\n        long long max_val = INT_MIN;\n        for(int j = 0 ; j<nums.size() ; j++)\n        {\n            int i =0;\n            int k = nums.size()-1;\n            long long max_i = 0;\n            long long max_k = 0;\n\n            for(int i = 0 ; i<j ; i++)\n            {\n                max_i = max(max_i , (long long)nums[i]);\n            }\n            for(int k = j+1 ; k<nums.size() ; k++)\n            {\n                max_k = max(max_k , (long long)nums[k]);\n            }\n\n            max_val = max(max_val , (long long)(max_i - nums[j])* max_k);\n        }\n    return max_val;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"maximum-value-of-an-ordered-triplet-i","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":527}
